scene kirinretrieval1
: You!
: Me?
: No, you!
: Me?
: Her?
: Yes!
: Do you...want some?
: Yes! But not in the context you are referring to!
scene kirinretrieval2
: Kirin, what’s going on? It’s not like you to storm into a room with feelings any bigger than concern for the amount of penises you have inside of you.
: What’s “going on” is that I was having perhaps the single cutest moment of my young life and that fucking semen demon showed up and ruined everything!
: Which one? You’ve gotta realize that’s how I see like 90%% of the class at this point.
scene kirinretrieval3
: Chika! Who else would I come to you screaming about?! Get with the fucking program, Yumi! Do something!
: The fuck do you want me to do? Throw meat at her? I’m eating.
: I don’t care what you do! Just make her go away so I can make passionate love to the teacher!
scene kirinretrieval4
: Why is nothing easy anymore?
: Love?
: Or...sex or...fucking or whatever you want to call it.
: Kirin, tell us exactly what happened or we won’t be able to do anything about it.

: Are you not fucking listening? I won’t be able to do anything about it either way. Chika’s like an entirely fuckin’ different person all of a sudden and I ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea about how to handle her.

: Okay. But still, Kirin should tell us everything anyway because I’ve never heard her use the phrase “making love” in regard to herself before and I want to know how that found its way into her head.
scene kirinretrieval5
: It...It doesn’t matter what led to me learning new phrases! I was just talking to Sensei and stuff and then...you know...semen demon!
: I’m pressing X so hard right now. You don’t even know.

: Did she swipe him from you or some shit? Because if that’s the case, just let her have him for a little while and wait until she’s done. There ain’t shit any of us can do about it. Girl’s fierce as all hell.
: Well, it’s...less like she swiped him and more like I...gave him away...
scene kirinretrieval6
: Then take him back, idiot! Telling me is counterproductive when I want him even harder than you do!
: Nuh-uh! You’re too nice to take him for yourself, so I know you’ll help me! And Yumi’s the only person I know who can probably reason with Chika!
: Stop using my martyr complex against me! It’s too effective! I’m in!
: Well, I’m not. I don’t give a shit about whoever is fucking the teacher at any given moment here.
: In fact, maybe he can screw Chika back into being an actual human again? Beats me. Only one way to know for sure. Can I eat now?
scene kirinretrieval7
: No. You can eat later. We have to go save Kirin’s heart. This is the first sign of life it has ever showed and I’ll be damned if I let it slip through the cracks.
: Why are you touching me?
: Because we’re in love.
: No. We ain’t.
: I’ve already talked you out of wearing the sarashi and I will talk you out of heterosexuality next.
scene kirinretrieval8
: You haven’t talked me out of shit, weirdo!
: Those double-D’s say otherwise, damn it.
: Can you two stop flirting and come help me already?! I want my moment back!
scene black
: To the Batmobile! Away!
: Wait! Don’t take my fuckin’ food out of my-
: You won’t be able to focus if there’s meat around! I know how omnivores function! Kirin, where are we going?
: It’s, like...half a mile that way. Just hug the wall and you won’t get lost!
: What are we even supposed to be doing?!
scene kirinretrieval9
The mission was simple — infiltrate the bedroom and find a way to restore Kirin’s first “lovemaking” opportunity.
But just because it was simple didn’t mean it would be easy. Chika Chosokabe was rabid after all. And it takes a trained professional to deal with creatures like that.
Or a gun. But Ayane Amamiya wasn’t around. And Kirin wasn’t about to ask her for help since A — she didn’t know where she was. And B — she didn’t think Ayane would help to begin with.
Regardless, Kirin was trying not to think about what might be happening behind that door because she didn’t want her first taste of love being wasted on someone else.
At the same time, though, she was beginning to question whether or not it was “love” to begin with if Chika was telling the truth about the way Akira had been spreading himself out.
She was thinking about all sorts of things to try and cope with this loss. Things she didn’t want to say out loud. Things that would embarrass her. Things about the past and things about the future.
But more than anything, she simply didn’t want this to slip away.
For far too long, she’s been letting that happen — pretending she doesn’t want what she knows she does because she feels like she needs to fit a certain image in order to stand out.
But this time — this time, she thought it would be okay to want something. So much so that she didn’t even think about how this might be hurting those she brought here to help her.
If it would even hurt them at all, that is.
They have much thicker skin than she does.
: They were in there the...last time I saw them.
: And you just...left them there? In what is presumably a romantic bedroom with a really soft king-size mattress?
: I think it was bigger than a king. It was one of those princess bed things.
scene kirinretrieval10

: Oh, Kirin...You left Sensei and Chika alone on a princess bed? Leaving him in that situation with anyone is a recipe for disaster — let alone a girl who, according to Yumi, has gone absolutely cock-crazy.
: Okay, for the record, I have never used the term “cock-crazy” in my life.
: It’s accurate though, isn’t it?
: I don’t fuckin’ know, man. She’s just...friggin’ delusional all of a sudden. Like she’s thrown out all reason and morals or whatever because she thinks he’ll tell her to fuck off if she doesn’t.
scene kirinretrieval11
: That’s a classic case of cock-craziness, alright. So basically, to help Kirin, we must first help Chika.
: Help Chika later. Just rescue Sensei for now so he and I can pick up where we left off and screw-love-fuck each other’s brains out.
: Got it.
scene kirinretrieval12
: Well, the first course of action is finding out if they’re-
: Yes! Yes! Harder! Just like that! Oh, fuck! I’m cumming! I’m...fucking cumming!
scene kirinretrieval13
: Uh...phase one complete, I guess.
: Hah...
: Thank you for forever tainting my ears, Noriko. Now, even if me and Chika do manage to get close again, I’ll be stuck remembering the way she sounds when she’s getting her back blown out.
: I’m honestly surprised to find out that’s not something you’ve already heard before.
scene kirinretrieval14
: Yeah! Well, unlike you two, I try to avoid situations where I’d be bumping into people having sex!
: It’s not like I’m actively trying to encounter that! I love Sensei more than anyone! He’s just...having sex like 50%% of his waking life! It’s going to happen if you’re involved with him!
: Of course he was just lying...
: That makes way more sense than expecting he’d actually be able to fall for a girl like me.
: Hm? What was that about lying? I couldn’t really-
: Don’t worry about it, Noriko. I’m just making myself look like a fucking idiot again for thinking anyone would ever choose me over someone else.
scene kirinretrieval15
: What? But you’re not-
: Nice?...
: Smart?...
: Funny? Caring? Pretty?...
: Why is it so much harder to name things that I’m not than things that I am?!
scene kirinretrieval16
: That’s not what I was trying to-
: I...I know! Because you are good! Too good! Fucking...annoyingly good! You’re the exact type of person who someone would fall for! I’ve never been that! Not for a day in my life!
: So why did I fucking believe it, Noriko?! Why did I think for even a second that I might be wrong about myself?! About who I am and what I’m worth?!
: Kirin-
: I’m going home...
: Thanks for trying.
scene kirinretrieval17
: Now do you see why I never try to get involved with any of this shit?
scene kirinretrieval18
: All this romance and...sex and...everything.
: All it does is make people fucking crazy.
: Everywhere I look, someone’s either getting hurt or...changing everything about themselves for no reason other than wanting to be with someone else.
: Isn’t being alone just...so much safer than that?
: It is...but we already know that, Yumi. Sensei knows it too. That’s why he’s so desperately trying to push everyone away all the time.
scene kirinretrieval19
: Then why-
: Because we can’t help it.
: I don’t...
: I don’t get it.
: Neither do I. But no one said there needs to be logic to any of this. We’re just a bunch of idiots running around trying to experience and feel new things.
: You might be perfectly content with just never doing that. And that’s awesome. But Kirin can’t sit still the way you can.
scene kirinretrieval20
: She’s always wanted someone to look at her. But not like how you and I look at each other. Like...REALLY look at her. As a girl...a woman...a princess...whatever she wants to be that day.
: But she’s never felt like she deserves it. So of course she’d take it hard on herself if...
: If she heard the person she’s been trying to catch the eye of say one thing then do another.
: Well...what the fuck do you think he said to her then?
: The same thing you’ll want to hear sooner or later when YOU can’t sit still anymore.
: The most terrifying...most amazing thing you could ever say to anyone.
: I think that’s what she heard tonight.
: That’s why I’m not chasing after her.
But Noriko didn’t need to chase after Kirin.
She’d find her way back to normal sooner or later.
She just needed to hurt a little first.
if ayanelust10 == False:
And what better place to hurt than all on your own?
: Kirin? Is everything-
: Fuck off, Ayane. You’re the second-to-last person I want to talk to right now.
scene kirinretrieval21
: What? Who the hell is the last then?
: Another blonde! Just...one parading as something she’s not!
: No! Fucking...ugh!
: Merry Christmas! Goodnight!
scene black
: G...Goodnight?
Kirin has left the party!

And what better place to hurt than in the arms of a rival?
: What the hell happened to you?
scene kirinretrieval22
: Oh, wouldn’t you like to know?!
: A little, yeah. But only because I’m mildly curious about what sort of tragedy it would take to make you look like you’re actually experiencing human emotions for once.
: Cool! So let’s fucking talk about it then!
: What?
: You and me! Let’s talk! Right now!
scene kirinretrieval23
: Why? I don’t want to know that badly.
: Because no one else will fucking get it!
: And I will?
scene kirinretrieval24
: I don’t fucking know, Ayane! Just come over here!
: Ugh...seriously?
scene black
scene kirinretrieval25
: So, did one of our classmates rape you this time?
: Obviously fucking not.
: Oh, okay. I just figured that since it was something “no one else would get,” it had to be that.
: She might as well have. Certainly fucking feels like she did.
: Yeah, I think you might be lacking some critical understanding of how it feels to be sexually assaulted here.
: I’m fucking sorry about that, okay?
scene kirinretrieval26
: Yup. You’re completely forgiven now. Thanks, Kirin.
: Ayane, you’re in love with Sensei. Right?
scene kirinretrieval27
: Of course.
: And if I said I was too...what would you think about that?
: I’d think that you’re a delusional and hypersensitive piece of shit human who could never possibly feel such a wholesome emotion.
scene kirinretrieval28
: Right?!
: You weren’t supposed to agree.
: No, I do agree! Because that’s exactly how I’m supposed to feel! But all of a sudden, my whole fucking world has been flipped on its head and I don’t know what to do about it!
: Uhhh...
: What if I really do love him, Ayane? How can I ever expect him to actually love me when I’m like...this?
scene kirinretrieval29
: You’re like...the ideal girl. Better than me at virtually everything. Except for maybe, like...blowjobs.
if ayanebjcontest == True:
: I’m better at those too. I won the contest the second time you forced me into sexually engaging with you. Remember?
: Yeah, but I’ve improved a lot since then.
: Fantastic.
else:
: Thank...you?
: Either way, I can’t fucking hold a candle to you. So if, for some reason, Sensei did tell me he loves me...it would totally have to just be him fucking with me. Right?
: He didn’t...actually say that. Did he?
: He might have. But it might have also been in the middle of him talking to, like...ghosts or something? I don’t know. It was weird.
scene kirinretrieval30
: Hah...
: I’ve never felt this way before, Ayane. I have no idea what to do.
: Like, it makes total sense for you to be all broken up about him fucking everyone ever. But for me, that’s only, like...kind of mattered. But now it suddenly matters a lot more and I hate it.
: And you want...what? My advice on how to cope with that? Even though you’ve effectively traumatized me for life and I want you to go away forever?
: Yeah. Kind of.
scene kirinretrieval31
: You have no shame at all, do you?
: Sure I do. I actually feel super bad about the whole sexual assault thing since you took it way worse than I ever expected you to.
: You expected me to enjoy being sexually assaulted?
: Maybe a little?
: That’s fucking stupid, Kirin.
: Yeah! That’s why I’m all shameful about it. But at the end of the day, I still like...want to be friends with you and stuff.
scene kirinretrieval32
: What?
: Yeah. I, like...really admire you, Ayane.
: And I, like...really want to throw up now.
: Like it or not, we have a lot in common. So shouldn’t you want to help me if it means I’ll become less of a shitty person and stuff?
: I think you’re overestimating just how much I can help you.

: There’s no secret method when it comes to coping with the man I love having sex with, like...all of my friends. It sucks. And it’s going to keep sucking forever. But it’s unavoidable when it comes to Sensei.
: I see, I see...
: But when he tells you he loves you despite that...you still believe him?
scene kirinretrieval33
: It sounds...extremely stupid when you put it that way. But yeah.
: Do you think he’s just like...poly then?
: I don’t know, Kirin...
: But what I do know is that he has an extremely hard time both thinking and saying those words to anyone.
scene kirinretrieval34
: So if he said them to you...I doubt he was lying.
: ...Really?
: Stop looking at me like that. I don’t want to feel bad for you.
: Thank you, Ayane...Really.
: And I’m sorry. I’m seriously...seriously sorry.
: I know that we probably won’t ever be friends again after what I did to you. But if you ever-
: Are we done here?
scene kirinretrieval35
: ...Yeah.
scene black
: Sorry again...
